messages:
IncidentBot: [ALERT] 2024-04-02 03:46 UTC - anomalous GET patterns against s3://redwood-prod-audit-logs/ detected by storage-guard. Potential exfil attempt. Trigger: >10 distinct IPs requesting same recent log objects within 30m. Auto-rate limit applied.
Tom SRE: oncall here, looking now. Can someone confirm which prefix/prefixes are affected?
Aisha Sec: I see requests for the /service/audit/2024/03/ prefix and a few for /service/kvcache/2024/03. Appears read-only S3 access keys were used.
Tom SRE: running quick list of presigned URLs and recent IAM token activity.
Ravi PM: how widespread could this be? any customer content in those audit logs?
Aisha Sec: audit logs contain request metadata (timestamps, route, model_id) and redacted user identifiers (hashed user ids). No plaintext user content should be in those logs per retention pipeline, but we need to confirm.
Marta Legal: hold on communication until scope is clear but begin drafting a potential customer notice. If hashes could be reversible or linkable we treat as potential exposure. Also consider regulator 72-hour window if personal data impacted.
Priya CS: I'm preparing a short customer advisory template we can send to affected accounts — prefer proactive transparency but contingent on scope.
Sam Ops: I've rotated the access key that appears to be used and disabled the presigned URL issuance service for the last 2 hours. Working on reissuing keys behind stricter conditions.
Tom SRE: quick findings: 1) IPs are from VX hosting provider; 2) only objects between 2024-03-28 and 2024-03-30 were requested; 3) no public bucket policy.
Aisha Sec: running a hash-reversibility check and matching affected hashed IDs against our mapping store. ETA 40m.
IncidentBot: Incident ticket created: INC-2024-041-77. Pager rotation notified: Tom SRE -> Kev (in 45m).
Ravi PM: OK main ask for thread — we need (A) a one-line status page copy, (B) a short customer potential-exposure template (scoped, non-alarmist), and (C) internal comm bullet points for execs. Drafts please.
Priya CS: draft customer notification (short):
```
Hi [Customer],
We detected unusual access activity that may have included metadata from audit logs associated with your account. At this time, we have no evidence that plaintext user content was accessed. We're actively investigating and will provide a follow-up within 24 hours with scope and mitigation steps. If you have specific compliance questions, reply and we'll connect you with our security team.
— Redwood Inference Security Team
```
Aisha Sec: tweak: change "may have included metadata" -> "may have included redacted request metadata (timestamps, endpoints, hashed IDs)" and add: "We have rotated affected credentials and mitigations are in place."
Marta Legal: also add: "If we confirm personal data is involved we will notify regulators as required and provide a follow-up with remediation details." Keep it factual and avoid probabilities.
Tom SRE: status page draft (short):
```
Status: Investigating a security incident affecting access to a subset of audit logs. Customers may receive direct notices if their data is in scope. No service impact to API availability. Updates: investigating, mitigations applied, will follow up within 24 hours.
```
Ravi PM: good. Also need an internal exec bullet pack for the CTO/CEO: 3 bullets max.
Priya CS: internal exec bullets draft: 1) What happened (anomalous reads against audit logs; rate-limited and keys rotated). 2) Current impact (potential limited metadata exposure; no evidence of plaintext content). 3) Next steps (scope confirmation in 24h, customer notices to affected accounts, regulator assessment).
Marta Legal: add: expected timeline for regulator notification if PII confirmed: 72 hours from detection. Include privacy officer contact.
Aisha Sec: update: mapping done for 85% of hashed IDs in the affected objects. We have identified ~12 customer accounts with matching hashes; flagging them as HIGH priority.
Tom SRE: can we safely send the customer template to those 12 now with the phrasing "potentially impacted"?
Marta Legal: yes, send as "potentially impacted" but do not admit data breach until we've verified reversible linkability. Also include contact instructions and mitigation steps we took (rotated keys, increased monitoring).
Priya CS: sending targeted outreach to the 12 customers now (email + secure customer portal message). I'll paste copy after send. :email:
Priya CS: SENT to 12 accounts at 04:55 UTC — message in thread with ticket link.
Sam Ops: blocking rules applied to the offending IP ranges and adding WAF signature for the access pattern. Also snapshotting the affected objects and moving to isolated bucket for forensic analysis.
Aisha Sec: forensic note: no write operations observed, only GETs. Attribution incomplete — pursuing host provider takedown request.
Tom SRE: handoff note — I'm on until 06:00 UTC; Kev will take over after that. Please log any customer replies to INC-2024-041-77.
Marta Legal: request for CS copy of the exact message sent and list of recipients for legal record.
Priya CS: pasted the exact message and recipient list into the incident ticket.
IncidentBot: Status update scheduled for 24h and ad-hoc updates on investigator findings. Reaction :white_check_mark: recorded.
